back:
In Visual Studio, right click on your project in the Solution Explorer, and choose Properties, then the VC++ Directories tab. From here, you will see a line called Include Directories. Add the directories you’d like the compiler to search for additional headers there.

This way, if you ever change your directory structure, you only have to change a single compiler or IDE setting instead of every code file.
front: What is the proper way to include header files from external directories?
source_prefix: s there.For gcc usersUsing g++, you can use the -I option to specify an alternate include directory:g++ -o main -I./source/includes main.cppThere is no space after the -I. For a full path (rather than a relative path), remove the . after -I.For VS Code usersIn your tasks.json configuration file, add a new line in the “Args” section:"-I./source/includes",There is no space after the -I.
